source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore electronics output in 2020 was influenced by electronics demand, semiconductor demand, and work-from-home demand.
Global chip shortage conditions and consumer electronics demand affected electronics production patterns.
Data center chips and wafer demand supported parts of the electronics manufacturing base.
Supply constraints and changing export demand shaped electronics output during the year.
